I'll think through this as the farmer would.

---

I farm 20 mu alone — my son works in the city, my wife helps sometimes but mostly it's me. That's a lot of land for one man at 59. I have to be careful not to take on too much work.

My land is wheat-maize rotation on most of it, like everyone around here in Quzhou. Cotton I keep on a smaller piece — maybe 4 mu — because cotton needs more hands for picking and spraying. If I plant too much cotton I can't handle it. Wheat and maize, the machine does most of the work — I pay the combine man when harvest comes.

So: 16 mu wheat-maize, 4 mu cotton.

**Wheat (winter, 16 mu):**
I plant after maize comes off in October. I use improved seed — the Jimai variety the agro-shop sells, everyone uses it now, gives good yield. Last year I put 2 bags of compound fertilizer (50 kg each, 15-15-15) per mu before ploughing, plus 1 bag urea (50 kg, so 23 kg N) at green-up in spring. That's around 22 kg N, 15 kg P, 15 kg K per mu roughly. I don't want to cut back — wheat price is not high but if yield drops I lose more than the fertilizer costs. I irrigate 3 times — before winter, at jointing, and at grain-filling. My well is deep enough. Spray 2 times for aphids and rust. Last year I got around 500 kg per mu, I expect similar.

**Maize (summer, 16 mu):**
After wheat in June. I no-till plant directly — saves me days of work, I can't plough alone on 16 mu in the short window. Hybrid seed, Zhengdan or Xianyu type, the dealer tells me which is good. I put one bag compound fertilizer at planting and one bag urea at big-trumpet stage — about 18 kg N per mu. Maize doesn't need as much water as wheat — 1-2 irrigations if the rains are poor. One spray for borer. I usually get 550-600 kg per mu.

**Cotton (spring, 4 mu):**
This one I work harder on. Plough it properly — cotton needs loose soil. I use improved Bt cotton seed — it saves many sprays, worth the extra seed cost. Compound fertilizer 50 kg per mu as base, urea at bud stage and flowering — total around 16 kg N per mu. Irrigate 3 times. Still need to spray 4-5 times for aphids, spider mites, even with Bt. Pick by hand — takes weeks, I sometimes hire a neighbor's wife. Yield maybe 250 kg seed cotton per mu if weather is okay.

I won't change much from last year. What worked worked. Fertilizer got more expensive but I can't cut — my land is tired, needs feeding.
